title: Flow matching achieves almost minimax optimal convergence
tldr_zh: 高斯条件核 FM 在 Besov 类上 W_r(1≤r≤2) 率 n^{-(s+1/(2κ)-δ)/(2s+d)}，σ_t≍√t 时几乎 minimax，与扩散持平
tldr_en: Gaussian-kernel flow matching attains W_r rate n^{-(s+1/(2k)-delta)/(2s+d)} on Besov densities; almost minimax iff sigma_t ~ sqrt(t), matching diffusion models.
key_numbers: Minimax lower bound n^{-(s+1)/(2s+d)} (Prop. 2, Niles-Weed–Berthet 2022); optimal iff κ=1/2
Solving ODE to τ=1 with σ_min gives Gaussian KDE, MSE at best n^{-4/(4+d)} (Sec. 3.1)
